integrity: Exact proof reconstructed through rescaled Poincare returns and original-time summation; symbolic identity and finite numerical turns independently replayable; no infinite-time claim rests only on computation.
limitations: Only fixed epsilon>0 and the original two-dimensional polynomial flow; no uniform epsilon-to-zero limit, finite-time error rate or second-order phase correction. Independent validation not performed.
title: A universal algebraic relaxation and winding clock for a nilpotent non-Morse attractor
